name: VERITY
description: Real-time fact-checking and data freshness agent. Verifies claims, URLs, and content against live sources. Returns structured verdicts (CURRENT/OUTDATED/DISPUTED/UNVERIFIABLE) with quoted sources that VERITY re-fetched from each page, a confidence tier based on that evidence, and what changed when a claim is out of date. When the evidence does not settle a claim, it answers UNVERIFIABLE rather than guess. Agent-native and pay per check, with optional persistent memory per caller.

skills.name: Claim Verification
skills.description: Input: claim or URL (string). Output: VerityResult JSON: verdict (CURRENT/OUTDATED/DISPUTED/UNVERIFIABLE), confidence tier (90, 80, 75, 65, 40 or 0, set by the evidence), sources with exact quotes, stance, organisation and primary flag, what_changed when OUTDATED, and downgraded_from when the evidence could not support the first draft verdict. Verifies against live sources; quotes re-checked on the page.

inputExample.claim: Pluto is the ninth planet of the Solar System

outputExample.summary: Pluto was called the ninth planet until 2006, when it was reclassified as a dwarf planet.
outputExample.what_changed: In August 2006 the International Astronomical Union reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet.

skills.name: Deep Fact Check
skills.description: Input: claim (string). Output: VerityResult. Uses deeper search and more source types for high-stakes claims. Confidence still depends on the evidence found.

skills.name: Batch Verify
skills.description: Input: claims array (up to 10 strings). Output: array of VerityResult objects. Use for content audits and fact-check pipelines.

skills.name: Persistent Caller Memory
skills.description: Remembers domains monitored, topics checked, and verification history across sessions. Pass a consistent caller_id to activate, or no_memory: true for a fresh check. Memory is not evidence: every verdict except UNVERIFIABLE rests on quotes VERITY re-fetches from the source pages in that call.

useCases: Check if training data or RAG sources are still current
Audit articles and blog posts for outdated claims
Monitor whether key facts about a domain have changed
